texts.name: The Mossway
texts.blurb: A road of moss the wood keeps moving.

raw.name: The wood walks
raw.blurb: Every 118 seconds roots close 3 ways and open 3 others. A green glow marks the ways that are open.

people.name: The Moss-Abbess
greet: Careful, climber. The wood walks. Two wisps are bound in it, and the Moss Warden waits at its heart, far to the north. Free the wisps, cut the roots that feed it, and its door opens.

people.name: The Path-Lighter
greet: The paths move, but my lamps stay put. Mostly.

people.name: The Kiln-Mother
greet: You found the burners’ clearing? Then you can stand by it a while.

people.name: The Charm-Pedlar
greet: Shards for what you need. The wood takes nothing back, so I take shards.

quests.name: The Bound Wisps
intro: Clear the bark den, and its wisp follows you: lead it to the heart. Then the old stones: the Stag-Crowned guards the second wisp. Last, cut the three roots that feed the Moss Warden, and its door opens.
outro: The wisps are home, the roots are cut. The Moss Warden’s door stands open, far in the north. Rest first, then go in.

steps.text: Lead the wisp from the bark den to the heart
steps.name: The wisp

steps.text: Lead the wisp from the old stones to the heart
steps.name: The wisp

steps.text: Cut the three roots that feed the heart
Go to the Moss Warden’s door

quests.name: The Bark Widow
intro: The Bark Widow walks round the hollow oak. Fell it and the wood grows calmer.
outro: A relic from the old wood. Keep it.

quests.name: Old Rootfoot
intro: Old Rootfoot walks the far glades. Nobody lights the lamps while it does.

quests.name: The Spore Lamps
intro: Two spore lamps: one at the lantern shrine, one at the spring. Light both, stand by each a moment, and I can see the paths move.
outro: Now I can see. Take this, it was in the moss.

quests.name: The Lost Spade
intro: Bram the younger dropped a bundle in the thicket and will not go back for it. Carry it to the camp fire. A hit and you drop it.

steps.text: Bring the bundle from the thicket to the fire

quests.name: The Burners’ Watch
intro: My stacks lie past the burners’ clearing. Find them, then hold the clearing while I bring the charcoal in: the hounds smell the smoke.
outro: All in, and dry. Take this.

steps.text: Hold the clearing while the charcoal comes in

doors.name: The Moss Warden’s door
doors.locked: Roots hold the door shut. The Moss-Abbess has a quest about the wisps.

doors.name: The gate up
doors.locked: The gate is sealed. Its warden answers only once the Moss Warden has fallen.

lines: Another climber. I am Vesper. Walk into the thicket behind me and we see who is better. Win, and I fight beside you.

lore.name: The root stone
text: The wood was a field once. It walked away from the plough and has been walking since.
What you take for paths are roots, and what you take for roots are paths.

hound.name: Bark hound
hound.blurb: Fast, and hunts in a pack.

named1.name: The Bark Widow
named1.blurb: Walks round the old oak and strikes hard.

named2.name: Old Rootfoot
named2.blurb: Walks the far glades and strikes hard.

root.name: Feeding root
root.blurb: A root that feeds the heart. It cannot move; it throws thorns.

ruler.name: The Moss Warden
ruler.title: Green over everything
ruler.line: Cut the roots that feed it; it stands open when none is left
